mutations.name: Jcode host applies the requested reasoning effort to its session
mutations.expectRed: requested variant reaches the session as its reasoning effort

mutations.name: Jcode host delays the requested effort until after a session turn
mutations.expectRed: reasoning effort is set before the session's first turn

mutations.name: Jcode host verifies RuntimeInfo before applying effort
mutations.find: const runtime = config.model || config.variant ? await client.getRuntimeInfo(sessionId) : undefined;
mutations.replace: const runtime = config.model ? await client.getRuntimeInfo(sessionId) : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: variant without an explicit model verifies its runtime route before applying effort

mutations.name: Jcode host selects the active provider route instead of the first duplicate
mutations.find: const route = effectiveModel ? activeModelRoute(runtime, effectiveModel) : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: effort refusal keeps only its requested tier, effective model, fixed provider code, and accepted ladder

mutations.name: Jcode host refuses the launch when the provider rejects the tier
mutations.expectRed: a tier the provider refuses ends the launch

mutations.name: Jcode host renders unsupported capability as a bad tier
mutations.find: return new JcodeEffortUnsupported(requestedTier, identity.model, identity.provider, identity.apiMethod);
mutations.replace: return new JcodeEffortRefusal(requestedTier, identity.model, identity.provider, identity.apiMethod, []);
mutations.expectRed: capability refusal is not relabelled as a tier-ladder refusal

mutations.name: Jcode host redacts downstream effort rejection text
mutations.expectRed: downstream effort-refusal text never reaches stderr
